```cardsmith
card:
  system: simple
  card-type: simple
data:
  # The card's title, shown in the header of the front. Falls back to the note's file name when unset.
  name:

  # The card body — free Markdown (bold, italic, lists, line breaks, wikilinks) shown in the front content area.
  content:

  # A small source reference shown in the front footer — a rulebook page or a wikilink.
  reference:

  # The name of the game this card belongs to — displayed prominently on the card back.
  game-name:

  # The kind of card (e.g. "Item", "Spell", "NPC") — shown as a subtitle beneath the game name on the back.
  card-type-label:
```
